records.title: B Box Nanoswarm from B Main
records.description: From the B Main position shown in the original clip, aim at the left window and jump-throw a Nanoswarm toward the B Box plant area. The creator describes it as a forgiving lineup that covers the plant and surrounding ground. Follow the clip's visual standing and release references; no more precise callout is supplied.

source.author: kingmonkeyI
source.evidence: Tracker labels this as a Killjoy Corrode attack Nanoswarm lineup for B Box and gives the instruction to aim at the left window and jump-throw. The original 35-second clip and its location map were visually reviewed; its opening view is at B Main and the throw targets the B Box plant area. Riot patch 13.08 lists changes to defender paths into the back of B, Mid geometry, and the A plant zone, not the B Main-to-B Box throw area. Compatibility is inferred from the unchanged local throw and target geometry; not tested in a live match.
source.rightsBasis: The lineup remains linked to its original Tracker page; no video, image, thumbnail or screenshot was copied or rehosted.
